description_full: SES AI Corporation develops and produces AI enhanced lithium metal and lithium-ion rechargeable battery technologies for electric vehicles, urban air mobility, drones, robotics, battery energy storage systems, and other applications. It manufactures and sells residential and commercial ESS systems, li-ion, li metal battery cells and battery materials, such as electrolytes for automotive original equipment manufacturers and others. SES AI Corporation was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Woburn, Massachusetts.

financial_summary: SES AI Corporation is a small-cap consumer cyclical business with a $309M market cap on $21M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +929% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.
Returns on capital run at -543% against a 10% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests. Gross margins of 58% confirm genuine pricing power.
The company is burning through $61M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
On the balance sheet, interest coverage of 40× is fortress-like.

Shareholder yield is only 0.5%, a thin return of capital, and stock-based comp at 52% of revenue is silent dilution an owner has to account for, and insiders hold 16% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and profit capture is only 0.0× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
